_readme: Human verdicts, keyed by recommendation id. `published` means a person checked the entry and it holds up; `rejected` means it is not a recommendation and leaves the catalogue. Corrections to the content of an entry go in overrides.json instead — this file only answers whether an entry should exist. The pipeline never writes it, so verdicts survive every re-run.
